objectives.statement: Use basic place prepositions for being in a country or room, being at a school or activity place, going to a place, and being with a professional or host.
Use basic time prepositions for parts of the day, future time, past time, and duration.
Recognize that Norwegian prepositions do not map one-to-one to English and choose by meaning, not by direct translation.

notes: Merged A1 preposition lesson. Must cover basic place and time uses, with clear warnings that Norwegian prepositions do not map one-to-one to English. Include future om, past for ... siden, duration i, and common i/på/til/hos place contrasts.
